item.title: Rubble and digging waste dumped loose in communal areas, 17th August
item.description:
The landlords of St James Estate have been mass evicting residents in order to convert their homes which requires substantial digging for foundations. Until recently they were collecting this digging waste in skips. They've now started dumping loose digging waste directly in the communal areas of the estate. Residents live directly opposite this loose pile of dirt. As well as causing significant dust issues exacerbated by the heatwave, I can also see broken waste pipe in there, so this waste is possible contaminated with sewerage.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Acanthus Drive, Old Kent Road, Greater London
